author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: किञ्च भूताणां सर्वप्राणिनां बहिरंतश्च परं ब्रह्म तिष्ठतीत्यनुषज्यते । अन्यथाभावराहित्यादचरम् । सर्वदेशेषु चरणाद्गमनाच्चरम् । सूक्ष्मत्वादप्रतिघात्वात्तद्-ब्रह्माविज्ञेयं अग्राह्यमिन्द्रियाविषयः । सर्वगतत्वाद्दूरे अंतिके समीपे च स्थितं तत् ॥ १३.१६॥
translation:
It is inside and outside all beings; it is unmoving as well as moving; being very subtle it is incomprehensible; it remains far and near. (16.) 
V. Unmoving: incapable of being changed, moving: everywhere, i.e., all-pervading. Being very subtle: being a substance which does not offer resistance to other things coming in contact with it; hence it is not comprehended or even perceived. Being everywhere it remains both far end near. (16)
